incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired for service=canary-health-checks severity=critical — 88% failing canaries across us-west-2 after deploy r-2026-03-14-5. Trigger: canary-health-check (>5m failing). link: https://pd.example/INC1987654321

pd-bot: PagerDuty incident 1987654321 triggered; escalation policy: oncall-sre -> primary -> secondary. First page sent to tim (oncall).

 tim (oncall): acked: I'm on it. grabbing logs + checking deploy details. @maria heads-up.

 maria (sre): pulling canary logs now. seeing identical 502s from model-runtime-proxy when kv-cache warmup hits. small sample:```
ERROR model-runtime-proxy: upstream read failed, id=abc123, code=502, conn_reset
stack: com.rw.infer.ProxyException at ProxyHandler.java:84
```

 tim (oncall): thanks. which commit rolled? release tag r-2026-03-14-5 -> gitsha: f8a2d1e. Canary count=20 pods, failure per-canary ~ 17/20.

 liz (devops): checking infra side. k8s events look normal. CPU low, memory nominal. env var CHANGE: MODEL_KV_PREFETCH=true set in deploy. maybe kv prefetch blowup on startup.

 jen (eng lead): hold on rollback until we confirm blast radius. any customer impact metrics? latency spike or errors on hosted API?

 tim (oncall): quick metrics: hosted-api errors at 0.8% -> baseline 0.1%. small but rising. A few customers hitting 5xx. stack traces point to proxy timeouts to model-worker.

 maria (sre): can try immediate mitigations: 1) turn off MODEL_KV_PREFETCH via rollout patch to canary, 2) scale canary down to 2 pods to limit blast radius, 3) revert full deploy if mitigation fails. leaning to #1 first.

 liz (devops): I can flip env var in canary via kubectl patch now. command:```
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/canary-deploy MODEL_KV_PREFETCH=false --record
```

 tim (oncall): do it. also post curl healthcheck to confirm.

 liz (devops): patching... :gear:

 liz (devops): patch applied. restarting canary pods (rolling).

 maria (sre): watching logs... new pods starting. early logs show fewer 502s. healthcheck curl:```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://canary.health.us-west-2.redwood/api/health
``` returning 200 after 24s.

 tim (oncall): nice. traffic reroute? we only sent 10% traffic to canary. let's keep it at 0.5% for now.

 jen (eng lead): thanks team. what's root cause hypothesis? MODEL_KV_PREFETCH makes many concurrent kv read requests at startup, saturating model-worker connection pool. new kernel change increased parallelism in runtime -> exposed issue.

 maria (sre): agree. short-term: keep prefetch off and throttle canary concurrency. medium-term: patch runtime to bound kv-concurrency or add backpressure.

 pd-bot: PagerDuty: incident 1987654321 acknowledged by tim (oncall). escalation paused.

 incident-bot: automated note: deploy r-2026-03-14-5 will be marked for hold on other regions until root cause reviewed.

 liz (devops): rolling out a scoped revert flag in staging to test safer prefetch. command used:```
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/canary-deploy MODEL_KV_PREFETCH=false --record
```

 tim (oncall): monitoring metrics for 10m window. current 5xx back to baseline.

 maria (sre): canary success window 6m. recommending we 1) stop further region rollouts 2) create rollback patch for prod 3) schedule postmortem with eng.

 jen (eng lead): agreed. please create incident ticket and assign to eng/runtime + infra. I want a short RCA doc. Also add LaunchDarkly toggle to decouple prefetch from deploy pipeline.

 pd-bot: PagerDuty: incident 1987654321 status -> mitigated (manual action). Resolutions must include owner.

 tim (oncall): marking incident mitigated. timeline will be added to ticket. handoff to maria for follow-up.

 maria (sre): taking ownership of post-incident. I'll create a postmortem draft and schedule a 1-hr blameless review tomorrow. initial notes: cause=unbounded kv-prefetch concurrency interacting with new runtime parallelism; mitigation=disabled prefetch, limited canary traffic; next actions=listed in ticket.

 jen (eng lead): thanks. ensure customer-impact table in postmortem (which customers hit >1% errors). ops notify support to contact affected customers if needed.

 incident-bot: Incident 1987654321 updated: severity downgraded to warning for tracking; follow-up owner=maria (sre).

 tim (oncall): closing the page now. if metrics regress I'll reopen and escalate. good job team :thumbsup:

 maria (sre): adding links to PRs and runbook changes in ticket.

 pd-bot: PagerDuty: incident 1987654321 resolved by tim (oncall) at ts=1987654380.

 liz (devops): leaving a small note: we should add a readiness probe delay before kv-prefetch or make it lazy. filing infra task.

 jen (eng lead): will review RCA and approve rollout plan once fixes are in. thanks everyone.

 maria (sre): postmortem created: https://docs.internal/pmrs/INC-1987654321. will add timeline and action items.

 incident-bot: This thread will be archived. Remember to tag the postmortem with z-sev and deploy-regression.
